metadata.description: Multi-vendor benchmark-sourced compliance rules for network device configuration auditing

rules.description: Enable AAA new-model for centralized authentication, authorization, and accounting

vendor_patterns.juniper: set system login user|set system authentication-order

rules.description: AAA authentication must be configured for SSH, login, or enable access
rules.remediation:
aaa authentication login default local
aaa authentication ssh console LOCAL

vendor_patterns.cisco_ios: aaa authentication login-history|login on-failure log|login on-success log

rules.description: AAA authentication login history should be enabled for audit trail
Cleartext 'enable password' should not be used; use 'enable secret' with strong hashing instead
rules.remediation:
no enable password
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret <strong-password>

rules.description: Password encryption service must be enabled to protect stored passwords
Local user accounts must use strong passwords (min 8 chars, not easily guessable)
AAA accounting must be configured to log all administrative actions
rules.remediation:
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group tacacs+
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group tacacs+

rules.description: AAA authorization must be configured for command-level access control
rules.remediation:
aaa authorization exec default local
aaa authorization commands 15 default local

vendor_patterns.paloalto: set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet no

rules.description: Telnet must be disabled on all VTY lines; use SSH only

vendor_patterns.paloalto: set deviceconfig system service disable-ssh no|set deviceconfig system ssh

rules.description: SSH must be configured as the only remote access method on VTY lines

vendor_patterns.juniper: set firewall family inet filter|set system services ssh root-login deny

rules.description: SSH access must be restricted to specific subnets/interfaces

vendor_patterns.juniper: set system services ssh hostkey-algorithm|set system services ssh macs

rules.description: SSH strict host key checking should be enabled to prevent MITM attacks

vendor_patterns.juniper: set system services ssh (connection-limit|max-sessions)|set system login (idle-timeout|class .+ idle-timeout)

rules.description: SSH session timeout must be configured to prevent idle sessions
SSH key exchange must use strong groups (dh-group14-sha256 or higher); dh-group1-sha1 and dh-group5-sha1 are cryptographically weak

expected_value.description: Console timeout must be non-zero to auto-disconnect idle sessions

rules.description: Console timeout must be set to a non-zero value to prevent unauthorized access from idle sessions
Telnet timeout configuration suggests Telnet may be in use; Telnet should be completely disabled
rules.remediation:
no telnet timeout
clear configure telnet

vendor_patterns.juniper: set firewall family inet filter .+|set interfaces lo.+ filter input

rules.description: VTY lines should have access-class applied to restrict management access to trusted IPs
rules.remediation:
access-list 10 permit <trusted-network> <wildcard>
line vty 0 4
 access-class 10 in

rules.description: Exec timeout must be set on console and VTY lines to auto-disconnect idle sessions
rules.remediation:
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
line vty 0 4
 exec-timeout 5 0

vendor_patterns.juniper: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

rules.description: SSH version 2 must be enforced; SSH version 1 has known vulnerabilities
Default SNMP community string 'public' must not be used
Default SNMP community string 'private' must not be used

vendor_patterns.paloalto: set deviceconfig system snmp-setting access-setting version v3

rules.description: SNMPv3 should be configured for encrypted and authenticated SNMP communications
SNMP location should be cleared or set to a non-revealing value to avoid information disclosure
SNMP contact should be cleared or set to a non-revealing value to avoid information disclosure

vendor_patterns.arista: no ip http server|management api http-commands.*no protocol http
vendor_patterns.huawei: undo web-manager enable|undo http server enable

rules.description: HTTP server must be disabled to prevent unencrypted management access
HTTPS server should be disabled unless explicitly required for device management
CDP should be disabled globally or on untrusted interfaces to prevent information disclosure
LLDP should be disabled to prevent network topology disclosure
IP source routing must be disabled to prevent routing manipulation attacks
IP directed broadcasts must be disabled to prevent smurf amplification attacks
Finger service must be disabled to prevent user enumeration
BOOTP server must be disabled to prevent unauthorized network booting
Proxy ARP must be disabled to prevent traffic interception
TCP keepalives (inbound) should be enabled to clean up dead sessions
TCP keepalives (outbound) should be enabled to clean up dead sessions
FTP passive mode should be configured for secure file transfers
ASDM history should be disabled if ASDM is not in active use
Call-home and anonymous reporting should be disabled to prevent information disclosure
rules.remediation:
no call-home reporting anonymous
call-home
 profile CiscoTAC-1
  no active

rules.description: ICMP unreachable messages should be rate-limited to mitigate reconnaissance
ARP rate limiting should be configured to mitigate ARP flooding attacks
Non-connected ARP entries should be denied to prevent ARP spoofing
Syslog server must be configured for centralized log collection and analysis

vendor_patterns.fortinet: config log memory setting|set status enable

rules.description: Local logging buffer must be configured for on-device log retention

vendor_patterns.juniper: set system syslog time-format|set system time-zone

rules.description: Log messages must include timestamps with date/time for accurate forensic analysis
rules.remediation: service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone

rules.description: Logging trap level should be configured for appropriate syslog message filtering
IPsec SA PMTU aging should be configured for proper tunnel maintenance

vendor_patterns.cisco_asa: crypto ca trustpool policy|crypto ca trustpoint

rules.description: CA trustpool policy should be configured for certificate validation
RSA keys must be generated with a minimum modulus of 2048 bits for SSH
Login banner must be configured to display legal/warning notice before authentication
rules.remediation:
banner login @
Authorized access only. All activity is monitored and recorded.
@

rules.description: MOTD banner should be configured to display operational warnings
rules.remediation:
banner motd @
WARNING: Unauthorized access is prohibited.
@

rules.description: Hostname must be set for device identification in logs and management
Basic threat detection must be enabled to identify common attack patterns
Threat detection ACL statistics should be enabled for monitoring denied traffic patterns

vendor_patterns.juniper: set security screen ids-option .+ tcp syn-flood

rules.description: TCP intercept statistics should be enabled for SYN flood detection
Unused interfaces should be administratively shut down to reduce attack surface

vendor_patterns.juniper: set interfaces .+ unit .+ family inet filter

rules.description: Management interface should be restricted to management traffic only

vendor_patterns.fortinet: config system ntp|set ntpsync enable|set server

rules.description: NTP server must be configured for accurate time synchronization across all log sources
NTP authentication must be enabled to prevent time-source spoofing
rules.remediation:
ntp authenticate
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 <key>
ntp trusted-key 1

vendor_patterns.paloalto: set network virtual-router .+ protocol ospf auth-profile

rules.description: OSPF authentication must be enabled to prevent unauthorized route injection
rules.remediation:
interface <interface>
 ip ospf authentication message-digest
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 <key>

vendor_patterns.paloalto: set network virtual-router .+ protocol bgp .+ auth-profile

rules.description: BGP neighbor authentication must be configured to prevent unauthorized peering
Dynamic access policy should be configured for VPN access control
